name: app-solution-roadmap-slide-with-dashed-path-and-floating-ui
title: Four-step roadmap on lilac with indigo icon nodes and floating calendar, mood and map cards
whatItIs: A pale lilac board titled 'The Solution Roadmap' with an S-shaped dashed line linking four round indigo icon nodes, each with a faint giant numeral and label, beside floating UI cards: calendar, meal and hydration reminders, medication donut and mood chart, and a safe-zone map.
whatItMeans: Gentle and guided; the winding path turns features into a journey.
techniques: Link nodes with a winding dashed path.
Alternate UI cards left and right.

vocabulary.definition: Steps joined by a curved line.
A round icon marking a step.
A UI card with a soft shadow.
